## Necrophage Infector, Horrid Manticore (Augmented Manticore) (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
NE Large aberration  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft. low-light vision, scent Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 21, touch 11, flat-footed 19 (+2 Dex, +10 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 104 (8d8+40)  
**Fort** +7, Ref +3, Will +7  
**Defensive Abilities** DR 5/-, from the void  
**Immune** cold, disease, mind-affecting effects, poison  
**Weaknesses** limb weakness  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 10 ft., fly 50 ft. (clumsy)  
**Melee** bite +14 (1d8+7), 2 claws +14 (2d4+7)  
**Proboscis** +15 (1d8+10/x3, infect with necrophage)  
**Ranged** 4 spikes +7 (1d6+7)  
**Special Attacks** Infect with Necrophage (see above)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 15, **Con** 20, **Int** -, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 5  
**Base Attack** +6; **CMB** +14; **CMD** 18  
**Feats** Weapon Focus (proboscis)  


**Ecology**


**Environment** Any, dark tapestry  
**Organization** solitary, pair or with necrophage carrier  
**Treasure** none  


**Special Abilities**


**Limb Weakness (Ex)** If the necrophage is subject to a critical hit, it loses a limb, the limb lost can be randomly determined or chosen by the GM. If it loses a leg, it could cause the creature to become prone or if an attacking limb is severed, it loses a natural attack.
